name: netease-music-float
description: macOS floating widget for local music players (NetEase, Apple Music, QQ Music, …) with real audio spectrum.
author: baitang-bt

scripts.check: node --check electron/main.js && node --check electron/preload.js && node --check electron/state-store.js && node --check electron/media-remote.js && node --check electron/music-players.js && node --check electron/auto-update.js && node --check electron/netease-app.js && node --check electron/netease-playback-mode.js && node --check electron/netease-lyrics.js && node --check electron/audio-capture.js && node --check electron/audio-permission.js && node --check electron/fft.js && node --check electron/netease-identity.js && node --check electron/paths.js && node --check src/float.js && node --check src/spectrum.js && node --check src/theme-colors.js && node --check src/title-fonts.js && node --check src/settings.js && node --check scripts/start-electron.js && node --test test/*.test.js

extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: NeteaseFloat 需要「仅系统音频录制」权限以绘制真实声浪频谱。
